hero001.name: Hero 001
hero001.description: A strong and resilient fighter who excels in close combat, able to withstand heavy damage while dealing significant blows to enemies.

hero002.name: Hero 002
hero002.description: A ranged damage dealer who can inflict high damage from a distance, specializing in taking down enemies quickly with precise attacks.

hero003.name: Vampire
hero003.description: A powerful mage who uses dark magic to drain the life from enemies, restoring health while dealing damage.

hero004.name: Hero 004
hero004.description: A heavily armored warrior who can absorb massive amounts of damage, protecting allies and controlling the battlefield.

boss001.name: Boss 001
boss001.description: A formidable enemy that poses a significant challenge, requiring teamwork and strategy to defeat. It has high health and devastating attacks.

boss002.name: Boss 002
boss002.description: An even more powerful boss that tests the limits of the players' abilities, with unique attacks and mechanics that require careful planning to overcome.

boss003.name: Boss 003
boss003.description: The ultimate challenge, this boss combines devastating attacks with complex mechanics, requiring the best strategies and teamwork to defeat.
